SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."cdscode") AS charter_funded_schools_count
FROM "satscores" sat
JOIN "schools" s ON sat."cds" = s."cdscode"
WHERE sat."avgscrmath"::NUMERIC > 560
  AND s."fundingtype" = 'Directly funded';

SELECT s."phone"
FROM "satscores" sat
JOIN "schools" s ON s."cdscode" = sat."cds"
WHERE sat."numtsttakr" > 0
ORDER BY (sat."numge1500"::NUMERIC / sat."numtsttakr"::NUMERIC) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s."sname", s."avgscrwrite", sch."charternum"
FROM "satscores" s
JOIN "schools" sch ON s."cds" = sch."cdscode"
WHERE s."avgscrwrite" > 499
  AND sch."charternum" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s."avgscrwrite" DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.cdscode = s.cds
ORDER BY s.avgscrread DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT adm."admfname1" AS first_name, s."district", COUNT(*) AS name_count
FROM "schools" s
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES (s."admfname1"), (s."admfname2"), (s."admfname3")
) AS adm("admfname1")
WHERE adm."admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND adm."admfname1" <> ''
GROUP BY adm."admfname1", s."district"
ORDER BY name_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 2;

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.mailstreet = 'PO Box 1040'
  AND s.school ILIKE '%Youth Authority%';

SELECT s."school", s."ncesschool"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"::NUMERIC DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(s.numtsttakr::NUMERIC) AS avg_test_takers
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
WHERE sc.city = 'Fresno'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sc.opendate::DATE) = 1980;

SELECT s."gsoffered"
FROM "schools" s
WHERE s."longitude" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s."longitude"::NUMERIC) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.school, s.street
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON s.cdscode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.avgscrmath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.avgscrmath::NUMERIC DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT s."phone", s."ext"
FROM "satscores" sc
JOIN "schools" s ON s."cdscode" = sc."cds"
WHERE sc."avgscrwrite" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sc."avgscrwrite" DESC NULLS LAST
OFFSET 332
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.avgscrmath, sc.county
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
ORDER BY (s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrread + s.avgscrwrite) ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."street", s."city", s."zip", s."state"
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON s."cdscode" = sat."cds"
WHERE sat."numtsttakr"::numeric > 0
ORDER BY (sat."numge1500"::numeric / sat."numtsttakr"::numeric) ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."school", AVG(ss."avgscrwrite"::NUMERIC) AS average_writing_score, s."phone"
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s."cdscode" = ss."cds"
WHERE (s."opendate" IS NOT NULL AND s."opendate"::DATE > '1991-12-31'::DATE)
   OR (s."closeddate" IS NOT NULL AND s."closeddate"::DATE < '2000-01-01'::DATE)
GROUP BY s."school", s."phone";

SELECT
  f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)"::NUMERIC / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"::NUMERIC, 0) AS "free_rate"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.admfname1 ILIKE '%Kacey%'
  AND s.admlname1 ILIKE '%Gibson%';

SELECT s."county", s."school", s."closeddate"
FROM "schools" s
WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
  AND s."county" = (
    SELECT s2."county"
    FROM "schools" s2
    WHERE s2."statustype" = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY s2."county"
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY s."closeddate" DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT s."phone"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND f."Charter Funding Type" = 'Directly funded'
  AND s."opendate"::date > DATE '2000-01-01';

SELECT s."district", f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE s."admfname1" ILIKE '%Alusine%'
   OR s."admfname2" ILIKE '%Alusine%'
   OR s."admfname3" ILIKE '%Alusine%';

SELECT s.city, f."Low Grade", s.school
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.state = 'CA'
  AND s.latitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.latitude ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."admemail1"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."school", s."doctype"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE s."fundingtype" = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
    SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM schools s2
    JOIN frpm f2 ON s2."cdscode" = f2."cdscode"
    WHERE s2."fundingtype" = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT s."admfname1", s."admlname1"
FROM "satscores" sc
JOIN "schools" s ON s."cdscode" = sc."cds"
ORDER BY sc."numge1500"::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_non_chartered_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.county = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.charter = 0
  AND (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0)) < 0.18;

SELECT s.city, COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.magnet = 1
  AND s.gsoffered = 'K-8'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s.city
ORDER BY s.city ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT a."account_id", d."a2", d."a3"
FROM "account" a
JOIN "district" d ON a."district_id" = d."district_id"
WHERE a."frequency" = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a."date"::DATE) = 1993;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t."account_id") AS negative_balance_accounts
FROM "trans" t
JOIN "account" a ON a."account_id" = t."account_id"
WHERE t."operation" = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND a."frequency" = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND t."balance" < 0;

SELECT a."account_id"
FROM "account" a
JOIN "disp" d ON d."account_id" = a."account_id"
JOIN "client" c ON c."client_id" = d."client_id"
JOIN "district" dist ON dist."district_id" = c."district_id"
WHERE c."birth_date" = (
    SELECT MAX(c2."birth_date")
    FROM "client" c2
)
AND dist."a11" = (
    SELECT MAX(dist2."a11")
    FROM "district" dist2
)
GROUP BY a."account_id";

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a."account_id") AS account_count
FROM "account" a
JOIN "district" d ON a."district_id" = d."district_id"
WHERE a."frequency" = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d."a3" = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT d."a2" AS district, COUNT(l."loan_id") AS loan_count
FROM "loan" l
JOIN "account" a ON l."account_id" = a."account_id"
JOIN "district" d ON a."district_id" = d."district_id"
WHERE l."status" = 'A'
GROUP BY d."a2"
ORDER BY loan_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l."account_id") AS loan_count
FROM "loan" l
JOIN "account" a ON l."account_id" = a."account_id"
WHERE a."frequency" = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l."amount" >= 250000
  AND l."date"::date BETWEEN TO_DATE('1995-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('1997-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a."account_id") AS account_count
FROM "account" a
JOIN "district" d ON a."district_id" = d."district_id"
JOIN "trans" t ON a."account_id" = t."account_id"
WHERE d."a3" = 'north Bohemia'
  AND t."bank" = 'AB';

SELECT DISTINCT d."client_id"
FROM "trans" t
JOIN "account" a ON t."account_id" = a."account_id"
JOIN "disp" d ON a."account_id" = d."account_id"
JOIN "card" c ON d."disp_id" = c."disp_id"
WHERE t."operation" = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t."date"::DATE) = 1998
  AND t."amount"::NUMERIC < (
    SELECT AVG(t2."amount"::NUMERIC)
    FROM "trans" t2
    WHERE t2."operation" = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t2."date"::DATE) = 1998
  )
ORDER BY d."client_id" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l."account_id") AS running_contract_accounts
FROM "loan" l
JOIN "account" a ON a."account_id" = l."account_id"
WHERE l."status" = 'C'
  AND a."district_id" = '1';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a."account_id") AS account_count
FROM "account" a
JOIN "disp" d ON a."account_id" = d."account_id"
WHERE d."type" = 'OWNER'
  AND a."frequency" = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT DISTINCT c."client_id", c."birth_date"
FROM "client" c
JOIN "district" d ON c."district_id" = d."district_id"
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c."birth_date"::DATE) BETWEEN 1983 AND 1987
  AND d."a3" = 'east Bohemia'
ORDER BY c."client_id" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT c."birth_date"
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l."account_id" = a."account_id"
JOIN disp d ON a."account_id" = d."account_id"
JOIN client c ON d."client_id" = c."client_id"
WHERE l."amount" = 98832
  AND l."date"::date = DATE '1996-01-03'
  AND d."type" = 'OWNER';

SELECT l."amount" AS debt_amount, l."status" AS payment_status
FROM "loan" l
JOIN "account" a ON l."account_id" = a."account_id"
JOIN "disp" d ON a."account_id" = d."account_id"
WHERE d."client_id" = 992;

SELECT d."a2", d."a3"
FROM "loan" l
JOIN "account" a ON l."account_id" = a."account_id"
JOIN "district" d ON a."district_id" = d."district_id"
WHERE l."loan_id" = '4990';

SELECT DISTINCT c."client_id"
FROM "client" c
JOIN "disp" d ON c."client_id" = d."client_id"
JOIN "card" cd ON d."disp_id" = cd."disp_id"
WHERE cd."issued"::DATE = DATE '1994-03-03';

SELECT DISTINCT a."account_id"
FROM "account" a
JOIN "trans" t ON t."account_id" = a."account_id"
WHERE a."date"::DATE < TO_DATE('1997-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND t."amount"::NUMERIC > 3000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."card_id") AS classic_cards_eligible_for_loan
FROM "card" c
JOIN "disp" d ON c."disp_id" = d."disp_id"
WHERE c."type" = 'classic'
  AND d."type" = 'OWNER';

SELECT a."district_id"
FROM "order" o
JOIN "account" a ON o."account_id" = a."account_id"
WHERE o."order_id" = 33333;

SELECT SUM(t."amount") AS total_paid
FROM "trans" t
JOIN "disp" d ON t."account_id" = d."account_id"
WHERE d."client_id" = 617
  AND d."type" = 'OWNER'
  AND t."type" = 'VYDAJ'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t."date"::DATE) = 1998;

SELECT c."client_id"
FROM "client" c
JOIN "disp" d ON d."client_id" = c."client_id"
JOIN "loan" l ON l."account_id" = d."account_id"
WHERE c."gender" = 'F'
GROUP BY c."client_id"
ORDER BY MAX(l."amount") DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    AVG(d."a12"::NUMERIC) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(d."a13"::NUMERIC) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(d."a12"::NUMERIC) > AVG(d."a13"::NUMERIC) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS higher_year
FROM "district" d;

SELECT d."a15" AS committed_crimes_1995
FROM "account" a
JOIN "district" d ON a."district_id" = d."district_id"
WHERE a."account_id" = 532;
SELECT c."type" FROM "card" c JOIN "disp" d ON c."disp_id" = d."disp_id" WHERE d."client_id" = 9;

WITH female_clients AS (
    SELECT c."client_id", c."birth_date", d."a11" AS avg_salary
    FROM "client" c
    JOIN "district" d ON c."district_id" = d."district_id"
    WHERE c."gender" = 'F'
),
oldest AS (
    SELECT "client_id", "birth_date", avg_salary
    FROM female_clients
    ORDER BY "birth_date" ASC NULLS FIRST
    LIMIT 1
),
lowest_salary AS (
    SELECT "client_id", avg_salary
    FROM female_clients
    ORDER BY avg_salary ASC NULLS FIRST
    LIMIT 1
),
highest_salary AS (
    SELECT MAX(avg_salary) AS max_salary FROM female_clients
)
SELECT
    a."account_id",
    o.avg_salary AS lowest_avg_salary,
    h.max_salary - o.avg_salary AS salary_gap
FROM "disp" a
JOIN oldest o ON a."client_id" = o."client_id"
CROSS JOIN lowest_salary l
CROSS JOIN highest_salary h
WHERE a."type" = 'OWNER'
  AND o.avg_salary = l.avg_salary;

SELECT
  ((bal_a.balance - bal_b.balance)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(bal_b.balance, 0)) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN trans bal_a ON bal_a.account_id = l.account_id AND bal_a.date = '1998-12-27'
JOIN trans bal_b ON bal_b.account_id = l.account_id AND bal_b.date = '1993-03-22'
WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
ORDER BY l.loan_id ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d."a2", ((d."a13" - d."a12") / d."a12") * 100 AS unemployment_increment_percentage
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l."account_id" = a."account_id"
JOIN disp dp ON a."account_id" = dp."account_id"
JOIN client c ON dp."client_id" = c."client_id"
JOIN district d ON c."district_id" = d."district_id"
WHERE l."status" = 'D'
GROUP BY d."a2", d."a12", d."a13";

SELECT DISTINCT a."frequency"
FROM "account" a
JOIN "district" d ON a."district_id" = d."district_id"
JOIN "disp" dp ON a."account_id" = dp."account_id"
WHERE dp."type" <> 'OWNER'
  AND d."a11"::NUMERIC > 8000
  AND d."a11"::NUMERIC <= 9000;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l."date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 1997 THEN l."amount" ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l."date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 1996 THEN l."amount" ELSE 0 END))
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l."date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 1996 THEN l."amount" ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM "loan" l
JOIN "account" a ON l."account_id" = a."account_id"
JOIN "disp" d ON a."account_id" = d."account_id"
JOIN "client" c ON d."client_id" = c."client_id"
WHERE c."gender" = 'M'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l."date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) IN (1996, 1997);

SELECT a."atom_id", COUNT(DISTINCT b."bond_type") AS bond_type_count
FROM "atom" a
JOIN "molecule" m ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
LEFT JOIN "bond" b ON m."molecule_id" = b."molecule_id"
WHERE m."molecule_id" = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a."atom_id"
ORDER BY a."atom_id" ASC NULLS FIRST;
SELECT c."atom_id", c."atom_id2" FROM "connected" c WHERE c."bond_id" = 'TR000_2_5';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT a."atom_id"
FROM "atom" a
WHERE a."element" = 'c'
  AND CAST(SUBSTRING(a."molecule_id" FROM 3 FOR 3) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 10 AND 50;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS non_carcinogenic_atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a.element = 'na'
  AND a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT a2.molecule_id
    FROM atom a2
    WHERE a2.element = 'na'
  );

SELECT COUNT(a."atom_id") AS atom_count
FROM "atom" a
JOIN "molecule" m ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE a."element" = 'h'
  AND m."label" = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_triple_bond_molecules
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT m."label" FROM "molecule" m WHERE m."molecule_id" = 'TR000';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'n';

SELECT m."label"
FROM "bond" b
JOIN "molecule" m ON b."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE b."bond_id" = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT c."atom_id", c."atom_id2"
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "bond" b ON c."bond_id" = b."bond_id"
WHERE b."bond_type" = '#';

SELECT COUNT(c."bond_id") AS connection_count
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "atom" a ON c."atom_id" = a."atom_id"
WHERE a."atom_id" LIKE 'TR%\_19' ESCAPE '\';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a."atom_id")  
FROM "atom" a
JOIN "molecule" m ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
JOIN "bond" b ON b."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE b."bond_type" = '#'
  AND a."element" IN ('p', 'br');

SELECT b.bond_type, b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE SUBSTR(c.atom_id, 7, 2)::int = 45;

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT m."label"
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "atom" a ON m."molecule_id" = a."molecule_id"
WHERE a."element" = 'ca';

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN m."label" = '+' AND a."element" = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
  / COUNT(DISTINCT m."molecule_id") AS percentage
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "atom" a ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id";

SELECT b."bond_type"
FROM "bond" b
JOIN "connected" c ON b."bond_id" = c."bond_id"
WHERE (c."atom_id" = 'TR004_8' AND c."atom_id2" = 'TR004_20')
   OR (c."atom_id" = 'TR004_20' AND c."atom_id2" = 'TR004_8');

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT a."atom_id"
FROM "atom" a
JOIN "molecule" m ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
JOIN "connected" c ON a."atom_id" = c."atom_id"
JOIN "bond" b ON c."bond_id" = b."bond_id"
WHERE m."molecule_id" = 'TR012'
  AND a."element" = 'c'
  AND b."bond_type" = '=';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT b."bond_type"
FROM "bond" b
JOIN "molecule" m ON b."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE m."molecule_id" >= 'TR000' AND m."molecule_id" <= 'TR050'
ORDER BY b."bond_type" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN m."label" = '+' AND a."element" = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
   / COUNT(DISTINCT m."molecule_id")) * 100.0 AS percentage
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "atom" a ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id";

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN a."element" = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / COUNT(a."atom_id") AS ratio,
  m."label"
FROM "atom" a
JOIN "molecule" m ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE a."molecule_id" = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m."label";

SELECT a."element"
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "bond" b ON c."bond_id" = b."bond_id"
JOIN "atom" a ON c."atom_id" = a."atom_id"
WHERE b."bond_id" = 'TR144_8_19';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a."element") AS element_count
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "atom" a ON a."atom_id" = c."atom_id"
WHERE c."bond_id" = 'TR001_3_4';

SELECT a."element"
FROM "atom" a
JOIN "molecule" m ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE m."label" = '-'
GROUP BY a."element"
ORDER BY COUNT(a."element") ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN b."bond_type" = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b."bond_id") AS percent
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "bond" b ON m."molecule_id" = b."molecule_id"
WHERE m."label" = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT a."element"
FROM "atom" a
JOIN "connected" c ON a."atom_id" = c."atom_id"
JOIN "bond" b ON c."bond_id" = b."bond_id"
WHERE b."bond_type" = '='
  AND b."molecule_id" = 'TR024';
SELECT a."element" FROM "atom" a WHERE a."molecule_id" = 'TR151' AND a."element" = 'cl';

SELECT DISTINCT a."element"
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "atom" a ON a."atom_id" = c."atom_id"
WHERE c."bond_id" = 'TR001_2_4'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT a2."element"
FROM "connected" c2
JOIN "atom" a2 ON a2."atom_id" = c2."atom_id2"
WHERE c2."bond_id" = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m."molecule_id", a."element"
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "bond" b ON m."molecule_id" = b."molecule_id"
JOIN "atom" a ON m."molecule_id" = a."molecule_id"
WHERE b."bond_type" = '#'
ORDER BY m."molecule_id" ASC NULLS FIRST, a."element" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT a."element"
FROM "atom" a
JOIN "molecule" m ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE a."atom_id" = 'TR004_7'

    WHERE b2.category = 'Parking'
  )
ORDER BY e.event_name ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT m."phone"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" maj ON m."link_to_major" = maj."major_id"
WHERE maj."major_name" = 'Business'
  AND maj."college" = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences';

SELECT DISTINCT z."city", z."state"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
JOIN "zip_code" z ON m."zip" = z."zip_code"
WHERE mj."department" ILIKE '%Electrical and Computer Engineering%'
  AND m."position" = 'Member';

SELECT e."event_name"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE e."type" <> 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY e."event_id", e."event_name"
HAVING COUNT(a."link_to_member") > 20;

SELECT DISTINCT m."first_name", m."last_name", mj."major_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "expense" e ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "major" mj ON mj."major_id" = m."link_to_major"
WHERE e."cost"::NUMERIC > 100
ORDER BY m."first_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, m."last_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, mj."major_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."event_date"::timestamp) = 2019 THEN b."spent" ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."event_date"::timestamp) = 2020 THEN b."spent" ELSE 0 END) AS spent_difference
FROM "budget" b
JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."event_date"::timestamp) IN (2019, 2020);

SELECT m."member_id", e."event_id"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "event" e ON e."event_id" = a."link_to_event"
WHERE m."first_name" ILIKE 'Maya'
  AND m."last_name" ILIKE 'Mclean'
  AND e."event_name" ILIKE 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT e."cost"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "budget" b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
JOIN "event" ev ON b."link_to_event" = ev."event_id"
WHERE e."expense_description" ILIKE '%Posters%'
  AND ev."event_name" ILIKE '%September Speaker%';

SELECT DISTINCT m."last_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "event" e ON e."event_id" = a."link_to_event"
WHERE m."position" = 'Member'
  AND e."event_name" ILIKE '%Women''s Soccer%'
ORDER BY m."last_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT AVG(e."cost") AS average_cost
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "member" m ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE m."first_name" = 'Elijah'
  AND m."last_name" = 'Allen'
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e."expense_date"::timestamp) IN (9, 10);

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)::NUMERIC AS ratio
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement';

SELECT e."event_name"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
JOIN "member" m ON m."member_id" = a."link_to_member"
WHERE e."type" = 'Social'
  AND m."position" = 'Vice President'
  AND e."location" = '900 E. Washington St.';

SELECT DISTINCT m."first_name", m."last_name", a."link_to_event"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "member" m ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE e."approved" = 'true'
  AND e."expense_date"::date BETWEEN TO_DATE('2019-01-10', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2019-11-19', 'YYYY-MM-DD');

SELECT e."event_name", e."event_date"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "budget" b ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
JOIN "expense" ex ON ex."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
WHERE ex."expense_description" = 'Pizza'
  AND ex."cost"::NUMERIC > 50
  AND ex."cost"::NUMERIC < 100;

SELECT m."first_name", m."last_name", e."cost"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "member" m ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "budget" b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
WHERE e."link_to_member" IN (
    SELECT e2."link_to_member"
    FROM "expense" e2
    JOIN "budget" b2 ON e2."link_to_budget" = b2."budget_id"
    GROUP BY e2."link_to_member"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b2."link_to_event") > 1
)
ORDER BY e."cost"::NUMERIC DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, e.cost
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies';

SELECT m."first_name", m."last_name", i."amount"
FROM "income" i
JOIN "member" m ON i."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE i."date_received" = '2019-09-09';

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c"."currency" = 'EUR')::NUMERIC
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c"."currency" = 'CZK'), 0) AS "eur_to_czk_ratio"
FROM "customers" AS "c";

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "gasstations" gs WHERE gs."country" = 'CZE' AND gs."segment" = 'Discount')
  -
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "gasstations" gs WHERE gs."country" = 'SVK' AND gs."segment" = 'Discount') AS "difference";

SELECT p."description", COUNT(*) AS sales_count
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN "products" p ON t."productid" = p."productid"
GROUP BY p."description"
ORDER BY sales_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT c."currency"
FROM "customers" c
JOIN "transactions_1k" t ON c."customerid" = t."customerid"
WHERE t."date" = '2012-08-24'
  AND t."price" = 548.4;

SELECT c."segment"
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN "customers" c ON t."customerid" = c."customerid"
WHERE t."date" = TO_DATE('2012-08-23', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND t."time" = '21:20:00';

SELECT g."gasstationid", SUM(t."price" * t."amount") AS revenue
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN "gasstations" g ON t."gasstationid" = g."gasstationid"
GROUP BY g."gasstationid"
ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT gs."country"
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN "gasstations" gs ON t."gasstationid" = gs."gasstationid"
WHERE t."cardid" = 667467
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c."segment", SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
FROM "yearmonth" ym
JOIN "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
WHERE ym."date" = '201309'
GROUP BY c."segment"
ORDER BY total_consumption ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(t."price") AS avg_total_price
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN "customers" c ON t."customerid" = c."customerid"
WHERE c."currency" = 'EUR';

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c."currency" = 'EUR' THEN t."customerid" END) * 100.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t."customerid"), 0) AS eur_percentage
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = t."customerid"
WHERE t."date"::date = DATE '2012-08-25';

SELECT t."customerid"
FROM "transactions_1k" t
WHERE t."date" = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY t."customerid"
ORDER BY SUM(t."price") DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.gasstationid = g.gasstationid
WHERE g.country = 'CZE'
  AND t.date::DATE > TO_DATE('2012/1/1', 'YYYY/MM/DD');

SELECT DISTINCT gs."country"
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN "gasstations" gs ON t."gasstationid" = gs."gasstationid"
JOIN "yearmonth" ym ON t."customerid" = ym."customerid"
WHERE SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) = '2013'
  AND SUBSTRING(ym."date", 5, 2) = '06';

SELECT c."customerid", SUM(t."price") / NULLIF(SUM(t."amount"), 0) AS avg_price_per_item, c."currency"
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN "customers" c ON t."customerid" = c."customerid"
GROUP BY c."customerid", c."currency"
ORDER BY SUM(t."price") DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c."customerid", ym."consumption"
FROM "customers" c
JOIN "transactions_1k" t ON c."customerid" = t."customerid"
JOIN "yearmonth" ym ON c."customerid" = ym."customerid"
WHERE t."productid" = 5
  AND t."amount" > 0
  AND (t."price" / t."amount") > 29.00
  AND ym."date" = '201208';

SELECT ym."date" AS month, SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
FROM "yearmonth" ym
JOIN "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
WHERE c."segment" = 'SME'
  AND ym."date" BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
GROUP BY ym."date"
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(t."amount" * t."price") AS total_spent
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN "customers" c ON t."customerid" = c."customerid"
WHERE c."customerid" = 38508
  AND TO_DATE(t."date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2012-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TO_DATE(t."date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') < TO_DATE('2012-02-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD');

SELECT c."customerid"
FROM "yearmonth" ym
JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = ym."customerid"
WHERE c."segment" = 'LAM'
  AND ym."date" BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
ORDER BY ym."consumption" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.gasstationid = g.gasstationid
WHERE t.date = '2012-08-26'
  AND t.time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00'
  AND g.country = 'CZE';

SELECT SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) AS year, SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
FROM "yearmonth" ym
JOIN "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
WHERE c."currency" = 'CZK'
GROUP BY SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."customerid") AS customer_count
FROM "customers" c
JOIN "yearmonth" y ON c."customerid" = y."customerid"
WHERE c."segment" = 'KAM'
  AND y."date" BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
  AND y."consumption" < 30000;

SELECT AVG(ym."consumption") / 12 AS average_monthly_consumption
FROM "yearmonth" ym
JOIN "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
WHERE c."segment" = 'SME'
  AND LEFT(ym."date", 4) = '2013';

SELECT
  (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ym."consumption" > 46.73 THEN c."customerid" END)::NUMERIC
   / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c."customerid"), 0)) * 100 AS "percentage_lam_consumed_above_46_73"
FROM "customers" c
JOIN "yearmonth" ym
  ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
WHERE c."segment" = 'LAM';

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN c."currency" = 'CZK' THEN ym."consumption" ELSE 0 END) -
  SUM(CASE WHEN c."currency" = 'EUR' THEN ym."consumption" ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_difference
FROM "yearmonth" ym
JOIN "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
WHERE ym."date" BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212';

SELECT c."segment",
       (SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym."date", 4) = '2013' THEN ym."consumption" ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym."date", 4) = '2012' THEN ym."consumption" ELSE 0 END))
       / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym."date", 4) = '2013' THEN ym."consumption" ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 AS "percentage_increase"
FROM "yearmonth" ym
JOIN "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
WHERE c."segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  AND c."currency" = 'EUR'
  AND LEFT(ym."date", 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
GROUP BY c."segment"
ORDER BY "percentage_increase" DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT
  (ym12."consumption" - ym13."consumption") / ym12."consumption" AS "consumption_decrease_rate"
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN "yearmonth" ym12
  ON ym12."customerid" = t."customerid"
 AND ym12."date" = '201208'
JOIN "yearmonth" ym13
  ON ym13."customerid" = t."customerid"
 AND ym13."date" = '201308'
WHERE t."date" = '2012-08-25'
  AND t."price" = 634.8
LIMIT 1;
